name: Arcana
description: Arcana was a planet that held a stronghold constructed by the Nightsister witches of Dathomir thousands of years before the Battle of Endor. In 9 ABY, Ahsoka Tano took a map from Arcana which was believed to lead to the Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn.
